name: Palantir
rationale: PLTR is the cleanest long in the watchlist: 1W +31.68%, 1M +22.73%, 3M +11.39%, with strong positive alignment across horizons. The catalyst is fresh and real: AP reported that Palantir surged 29.5% after revenue leaped 93% and management raised full-year 2026 revenue guidance. That combination of strong multi-horizon momentum plus a verified earnings beat/guidance raise justifies a small starter
